subject: Civic Education
lesson: Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership: Thematic Station Jigsaw & Infographic Wall: Competency Level 8.2.4
unique_learning_outcome: Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership.
Explains the need of moral leadership for the wellbeing of society.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher writes or reads “Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership” and asks students to name one example they have seen in everyday life. Students share brief responses; the teacher connects their examples to Thematic Station Jigsaw & Infographic Wall: Competency Level 8.2.4 and explains how it will help them explore this period's outcome.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher delivers prompts/cue cards; students inspect tasks.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students explore teacher-designated board or discussion stations about 'Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership.'

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher facilitates role execution and formatively checks progress.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Home groups reassemble to teach peers and synthesize key ideas.

summary: Synthesize key student findings from Thematic Station Jigsaw & Infographic Wall: Competency Level 8.2.4, emphasizing the core principles of “Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership” and clarifying any lingering misconceptions.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Use the student's five-minute assignment response to check understanding of “Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership” and give one concise correction or affirmation.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Each student completes a short exit response explaining one finding about “Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership” using evidence or an example from Thematic Station Jigsaw & Infographic Wall: Competency Level 8.2.4. The teacher reviews responses for an accurate link to the period outcome.
selected_activity:
Activity: Thematic Station Jigsaw & Infographic Wall: Competency Level 8.2.4
Approach: Students explore teacher-designated board or discussion stations about 'Names the democratic leadership qualities in leadership.'. Home groups reassemble to teach peers and synthesize key ideas.
Student task: Explore station prompts, return to home groups to teach peers, and co-create a summary. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: Synthesized Civic Action Infographic Poster.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
